mechanism_narrative: The recent rebound in WORKPLACES mobility, combined with still-elevated TRANSIT and RESIDENTIAL levels, signals more commuter circulation and more discretionary stopping on the way home, so RETAIL_REC should rise over the next four weeks relative to the last four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its prior 28-day mean after WORKPLACES stays above -15 for two consecutive weeks while TRANSIT remains above -20.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS mobility falls sharply from one week to the next, outdoor leisure substitutes toward indoor retail and dining, so RETAIL_REC rises within two weeks after the drop.
failure_condition: A week-on-week PARKS drop larger than 5 points is not followed by a higher RETAIL_REC average over the next 14 days than over the prior 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM stays elevated while WORKPLACES improves, routine errand traffic and weekday footfall spill over into nearby retail trips, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise when GROCERY_PHARM remains above 20 and WORKPLACES improves for two straight weeks, indicating no spillover from errand and commute activity.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in RESIDENTIAL mobility above its recent plateau indicates stay-at-home behavior, which suppresses discretionary outings and keeps RETAIL_REC lower over the next month.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises above 8 and stays there for 2 weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL remaining above 8 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A continued upward drift in GROCERY_PHARM combined with flat or rising PARKS signals localized neighborhood activity that substitutes away from destination shopping, so RETAIL_REC should edge down over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline in the next 7 days when GROCERY_PHARM is above 25 and PARKS does not fall.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS mobility is already low and TRANSIT continues to recover, colder or less outdoor-oriented weeks shift activity toward indoor retail, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS stays below -20 while TRANSIT rises for 2 weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 14 days after PARKS stays below -20 and TRANSIT rises for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden improvement in WORKPLACES mobility after a prior weak week indicates a durable reopening impulse that feeds retail visits with a lag, raising RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises by at least 4 points week-on-week after being below -15
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its previous 28-day mean through the next 28 days after WORKPLACES rebounds by 4 points or more from a depressed level.

mechanism_narrative: If both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES keep recovering together, commuting density increases and supports short retail trips after work, producing a higher RETAIL_REC average over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next 28 days while both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES continue trending upward for at least two weeks.
